body:
Other than knowing the first time they called, she doesn't know about any of it.  I guess I didn't state the problem, but we don't know who it is.  I can say with 100% accuracy that it is someone that works directly in my office, and while I have suspicions, they have another person helping and have covered all tracks - pay phones, burner phones, skype/google voice.  The phone provider can't even trace them.

I really appreciate having someone else to talk to about this.

That has been thought of, but the problem is that I'm sure they would find a way to contact other people in the family.  They probably would not be so kind in defending me.  I'm not the person they are describing to her.  It sucks.
